name: Light armour
details: Provides no protection against weapons with the Energy keyword.

name: Energy shield
details: This armour may only provide protection against damage caused by weapons with the Energy keyword.

name: Psy-hood
details: The wearer of this armour cannot be targeted by arcane abilities or weapons with the Psychic keyword.

name: Heavy armour
details: The wearer suffers -1 to their agility during movement actions.

name: Living armour
details: This armour is a living being. At the start of each game roll 1D20. The armour now has that many hit-points. When the wearer is hit, remove the damage from the armour. If the armour loses all of its hit-points, it is destroyed for ever and offers no more protection.

name: Power armour
details: The wearer of this armour gains +1 to their agility. The wearer is immune to the effects of the Poisonous and Cumulative weapon special rules. If struck by weapons with the keyword Energy, roll 1D10. On a roll of 10 the armour's internal systems have been damaged and must be rebooted - the wearer must spend a turn repairing the armour, during which they may not make any actions.
